events.title: CVS opens CUA Agent Kit as OpenAI expands healthcare computer use
events.title_zh: CVS 开源 CUA Agent Kit，OpenAI 扩大医疗 computer use
events.summary: OpenAI made computer use available in its API and healthcare products. CVS Health also released CUA Agent Kit under Apache 2.0: an agent records a workflow, then Codex compiles it into deterministic Playwright or pywinauto automation that can run without an LLM. CVS says the pattern cleared one backlog and now executes tens of thousands of consult steps per day.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 将 computer use 开放到 API 与医疗产品。CVS Health 同时以 Apache 2.0 开源 CUA Agent Kit：agent 先记录操作流程，再由 Codex 编译成可脱离 LLM 运行的 Playwright 或 pywinauto 自动化。CVS 称该方案清理了一项积压，并已每天执行数万次会诊步骤。
events.why_it_matters: For teams automating repetitive browser or desktop work, the kit offers a testable path from flexible discovery to deterministic execution. Healthcare safety and deployment numbers are vendor-reported; traces and screenshots may contain credentials or protected data.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对自动化重复网页或桌面流程的团队来说，这套工具提供了从灵活探索转向确定性执行的可测试路径。医疗安全与部署数据仍来自厂商；轨迹和截图可能含凭据或受保护数据。

events.title: Tencent launches HY4 Flash as a low-cost multimodal API
events.title_zh: 腾讯发布低成本多模态 API HY4 Flash
events.summary: Tencent released HY4 Flash, a multimodal mixture-of-experts API with a 1M-token context. It has 224B total parameters, including 64B Engram parameters, and activates 12B per token. TokenHub lists $0.070 per million input tokens and $0.281 per million output tokens. Weights are not yet open.
events.summary_zh: 腾讯发布多模态 MoE API HY4 Flash，支持 100 万 token 上下文。模型总参数为 224B，其中包括 64B Engram 参数，每个 token 激活 12B。TokenHub 标价为每百万输入 token 0.070 美元、输出 0.281 美元。权重尚未开放。
events.why_it_matters: For cost-sensitive multimodal agent workloads, HY4 Flash sets an unusually low hosted price and is callable now. Speed, benchmark and internal workflow results are vendor-reported, and the promised open weights have not shipped.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对成本敏感的多模态 agent 工作负载来说，HY4 Flash 给出了很低的托管价格，而且现在可以调用。速度、benchmark 和内部工作流结果均为厂商自报，承诺的开放权重尚未发布。

events.title: OpenAI adds a restricted API classifier for potential CSAM
events.title_zh: OpenAI 新增受限的潜在 CSAM API 分类器
events.summary: OpenAI added omni-moderation-csam-latest to the Moderations API for approved organizations at no charge. It accepts one still image up to 20 MB and flags potential CSAM and potential AI-generated CSAM. It is not available for inline moderation or Batch API use.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 在 Moderations API 中新增 omni-moderation-csam-latest，免费提供给获批组织。它一次接收一张不超过 20 MB 的静态图片，并标记潜在 CSAM 与潜在 AI 生成 CSAM。该模型不支持 inline moderation 或 Batch API。
events.why_it_matters: For approved trust-and-safety teams, this creates a dedicated screening control inside an existing API. OpenAI publishes no performance benchmark, and the scores are neither calibrated probabilities nor legal determinations.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对获批的 trust-and-safety 团队来说，这在现有 API 内增加了一项专用筛查控制。OpenAI 没有公开性能 benchmark；分数既不是校准后的概率，也不是法律认定。

technical_details.input: one still image up to 20 MB
technical_details.interpretation_limit: scores are not calibrated probabilities; flags are not legal determinations and do not automatically report to authorities

technical_details_zh.输入: 一次一张不超过 20 MB 的静态图片
输出: 潜在 AI 生成 CSAM
technical_details_zh.解释限制: 分数不是校准概率；标记不是法律认定，也不会自动向主管机构报告
technical_details_zh.时间依据: API changelog 与指南更新于 2026-11-16

events.next_action_zh: 获批后先用合成与合规测试集测误报、漏报和升级流程，再决定是否接入生产审核。
events.next_action_en: After approval, test false positives, misses and escalation flow on synthetic and compliant data before production moderation.
